program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),       # diff pair L
    "Itail": (150e-6, 80e-6, 300e-6),
    "gmid3": (8.0, 6.0, 11.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # PMOS mirror L
    "gmidt": (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),      # tail current source gm/Id
    "Lt":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # tail L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    Itail = p["Itail"]
    I1 = Itail / 2.0

    # Tail current source + reference diode (same L, gm/Id) -> ratio Itail/iref
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], Itail, vds=0.25)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    # Diff pair: source sits at vcm - vgs1 (iterate for body effect)
    vs = 0.25
    for _ in range(3):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=vs)
        vs = max(0.05, vcm - m1.vgs)

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=1.0)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=m3.vgs)
    vout_dc = vdd - m3.vgs
    vds1 = max(0.1, vout_dc - vs)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vds1, vsb=vs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=m3.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: ibias current sunk by diode nfet
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: vinp drives the output-side device -> non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)      # diode side
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)   # output side
    # mirror load
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m4)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m4.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cpar = m1.cdd + m4.cdd + m4.cgd
    ctot = cl + cpar
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    # mirror pole (pole-zero doublet at 2*fp)
    cx = m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    # settling: slew portion for ~0.5 V step + linear 1% settling
    sr = Itail / ctot
    vstep = 0.5
    v_lin = 2.0 / (gm1 / I1)
    t_slew = max(0.0, vstep - v_lin) / sr
    tau = 1.0 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = t_slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = vdd * (Itail + iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "settle": settle,
        "slew": sr,
        "power": power,
    }
